name: Daily Issue Triage
description: Automatically triage new GitHub issues every morning
instructions:
Review all new GitHub issues created in the last 24 hours. For each issue:
1. Categorize by type (bug, feature, question, documentation)
2. Assign priority (P0-P3) based on severity and impact
3. Add appropriate labels
4. Suggest assignee based on area of expertise
5. Flag security issues immediately
6. Identify duplicates
7. Request more information if needed

Provide a summary report with:
- Total new issues
- Issues by priority
- Critical issues requiring immediate attention
- Recommended actions
